notes: OneMillionDollarToken (src/OneMillionDollarToken.sol) is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20 built on OpenZeppelin ERC20: name '1 Million Dollar', symbol '1MD', 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the entire supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) exactly once to msg.sender, the launch factory. There is no owner, admin role, mint, burn, burnFrom, pause, blocklist, fee or tax on transfer, proxy, delegatecall or selfdestruct, so the supply can never grow and no privileged call can move or freeze a holder's balance. Launch flows (factory to distributor, distributor claims, pool seed and swaps through the PoolManager) move exactly the amounts transferred. The launch deploys no application contracts. The pool pairs with IMD at 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 at the launch policy's 1.25% fee with tick spacing 60; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply, and pool.initialPrice is provenance only.
